slides.title: Text Preprocessing
slides.content:
# Cleaning Text Data 🧹

## Basic Preprocessing

```python
import re
import nltk
from nltk.corpus import stopwords
from nltk.stem import WordNetLemmatizer

nltk.download('stopwords')
nltk.download('wordnet')

def preprocess_text(text):
    # Lowercase
    text = text.lower()
    
    # Remove special characters
    text = re.sub(r'[^a-zA-Z\s]', '', text)
    
    # Tokenize
    words = text.split()
    
    # Remove stopwords
    stop_words = set(stopwords.words('english'))
    words = [w for w in words if w not in stop_words]
    
    # Lemmatization
    lemmatizer = WordNetLemmatizer()
    words = [lemmatizer.lemmatize(w) for w in words]
    
    return ' '.join(words)

text = "I'm LOVING these movies! They're absolutely amazing!!!"
clean = preprocess_text(text)
# Output: "love movie absolutely amazing"
```

## Preprocessing Steps

| Step | Before | After |
|------|--------|-------|
| Lowercase | "HELLO World" | "hello world" |
| Remove punctuation | "Hello!" | "Hello" |
| Tokenize | "hello world" | ["hello", "world"] |
| Remove stopwords | ["the", "cat", "is", "big"] | ["cat", "big"] |
| Lemmatize | "running", "ran" | "run", "run" |

> 💡 **Clean text = Better model performance!**

slides.title: Text Vectorization
slides.content:
# Converting Text to Numbers 🔢

ML models need numbers, not words!

## Bag of Words (CountVectorizer)

```python
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import CountVectorizer

corpus = [
    "I love python",
    "Python is great",
    "I love programming"
]

vectorizer = CountVectorizer()
X = vectorizer.fit_transform(corpus)

print(vectorizer.get_feature_names_out())
# ['great', 'is', 'love', 'programming', 'python']

print(X.toarray())
# [[0, 0, 1, 0, 1],   # "I love python"
#  [1, 1, 0, 0, 1],   # "Python is great"
#  [0, 0, 1, 1, 0]]   # "I love programming"
```

## TF-IDF (Better!)

```python
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer

vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=5000,  # Limit vocabulary
    ngram_range=(1, 2), # Unigrams and bigrams
    min_df=2            # Minimum document frequency
)
X = vectorizer.fit_transform(corpus)
```

## Word Embeddings (Best!)

```python
# Using pre-trained embeddings
from gensim.models import Word2Vec

model = Word2Vec(sentences, vector_size=100, window=5)
vector = model.wv['python']  # 100-dim vector

# Semantic similarity
model.wv.similarity('python', 'programming')  # 0.85
```

> 🎯 **TF-IDF for traditional ML, Embeddings for deep learning!**

slides.title: NLP Models
slides.content:
# NLP Models 🤖

## Traditional ML Approach

```python
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.naive_bayes import MultinomialNB
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline

# Text classification pipeline
pipeline = Pipeline([
    ('tfidf', TfidfVectorizer(max_features=5000)),
    ('clf', MultinomialNB())
])

pipeline.fit(train_texts, train_labels)
predictions = pipeline.predict(test_texts)
```

## Deep Learning Approach

```python
import tensorflow as tf
from tensorflow.keras.layers import Embedding, LSTM, Dense

model = tf.keras.Sequential([
    Embedding(vocab_size, 128, input_length=max_len),
    LSTM(64),
    Dense(1, activation='sigmoid')
])

model.compile(optimizer='adam', loss='binary_crossentropy')
model.fit(X_train, y_train, epochs=5)
```

## Transformer Models (State-of-the-Art)

```python
from transformers import pipeline

# Sentiment analysis
classifier = pipeline('sentiment-analysis')
result = classifier("I love this product!")
# [{'label': 'POSITIVE', 'score': 0.999}]

# Named entity recognition
ner = pipeline('ner')
entities = ner("Apple CEO Tim Cook visited Paris")
```

> 💡 **Transformers (BERT, GPT) are the current state-of-the-art!**

slides.title: NLP Applications
slides.content:
# Real-World NLP 🌍

## Sentiment Analysis

```python
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression

# Train classifier
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(max_features=5000)
X_train = vectorizer.fit_transform(reviews)
model = LogisticRegression()
model.fit(X_train, sentiments)

# Predict
new_review = ["This movie is amazing!"]
X_new = vectorizer.transform(new_review)
sentiment = model.predict(X_new)
```

## Named Entity Recognition (NER)

```python
import spacy

nlp = spacy.load('en_core_web_sm')
doc = nlp("Apple CEO Tim Cook visited Paris last Friday")

for ent in doc.ents:
    print(f"{ent.text}: {ent.label_}")
# Apple: ORG
# Tim Cook: PERSON
# Paris: GPE
# last Friday: DATE
```

## Text Summarization

```python
from transformers import pipeline

summarizer = pipeline('summarization')
long_text = "Very long article..."
summary = summarizer(long_text, max_length=100)
```

## Question Answering

```python
qa = pipeline('question-answering')
result = qa(
    question="What is Python?",
    context="Python is a programming language created by Guido van Rossum."
)
# {'answer': 'a programming language', 'score': 0.95}
```
